card.text: Yellow-white giant in Cassiopeia, seen nearly pole-on, spinning fast.

introduction.text: Caph spins so fast that its equator swells to 3.79 solar radii while its poles sit at 3.06. We see it nearly pole-on, 16.8 parsecs away.

sources.label: Che et al. 2011
sources.locator: Table 3, modified von Zeipel model (beta free), row R_eq

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: Measured colour, with hot bright poles and a cool equator from the star's fast spin. The darker edge is a model.
